[[File:ZamWesell-DaG.png|thumb|250px|right|Zam Wesell wearing [[Mabari armor]]weave]]
'''Armorweave''' was an armored cloth material capable of dissipating blaster bolts, and with at least limited resistance to lightsaber attacks. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], and the [[Count/Legends|counts]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] traditionally wore [[Cape/Legends|capes]]<ref name="ROTSN">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> and [[Jacket/Legends|jackets]] made out of armorweave. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and his [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] wore armorweave,<ref name="LE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] cape was also made of this material.<ref name="Dark Lord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> The [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] wore a [[Mabari armor|suit]] of [[Mabari/Legends|Mabari]] armorweave.<ref name="FF53">{{FactFile|53|WES 1-4|Zam Wesell}}</ref> The bodysuit under [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] was made of armorweave.

==Behind the scenes==
As a flexible material used to make armor wearable as typical clothes, armorweave has similarities to the real-world material [[Wikipedia:Kevlar|Kevlar]], famous for its use in modern bulletproof vests.
